ui.options.beammp.protectConfigFromClone: Protect this config from being cloned by other players.
ui.options.beammp.enableNewChatMenu.tool: The new chat menu uses ImGui. It's customisable, sleek and awesome!
ui.options.beammp.enablePosSmoother.tool: Tries to smooth position data from players with unstable connections, reducing vehicle warping/rubber banding
ui.options.beammp.autoSyncVehicles.toolt: If enabled, your vehicle parts will automatically be synced to other players after a few seconds
ui.options.beammp.queueSpawnEdit.tooltip: If enabled, remote vehicle spawns and edits will be put in a queue, instead of applying instantly
ui.options.beammp.queueAuto.tooltip: If enabled, you will only spawn queued vehicles once you come to a stop based on the settings below
ui.options.beammp.highlightQueuedPlayers: Highlight players who have queued events in the playerlist
ui.options.beammp.playerlistLeftclick.to: Choose what happens when you left click on a player name in the playerlist
ui.options.beammp.queueApplySpeed.toolti: Queues apply if your vehicle moves slower than this speed
ui.options.beammp.queueApplyTimeout.tool: Queues apply if your vehicle moves under your set speed threshold for this long
ui.options.beammp.queueAutoSkipRemote.to: If enabled and spectating other players, you will spawn queued vehicles right away
ui.options.beammp.queueSkipUnicycle.tool: If enabled, you will spawn other Unicycles (Snowmen/Beamlings) right away
ui.options.beammp.luaOptimisations.toolt: If enabled, other vehicles will run limited Lua calculations, improving performance
ui.options.beammp.debugOutput: Show network activity in the console
ui.options.beammp.launcherPort: Launcher port:[br]Don't change unless you have to
ui.options.beammp.launcherPortWarn: Don't change unless you have to
ui.options.beammp.launcherPort.tooltip: Set this to the custom port that the launcher was set to use.
ui.options.beammp.clearLauncherCache.too: Enabling this will clear the currently download mod cache of the launcher. Doing this will result in you having to download all mods for each server you join again.
ui.options.beammp.skipOtherPlayersVehicl: Disable switching to other players vehicles
ui.options.beammp.fadeVehicles: Fade out vehicles as they get closer
ui.options.beammp.fadeVehicles.tooltip: Good when paired with disabled collisions
ui.options.beammp.showPlayerIDs.tooltip: Enable to show player ID's in the player list.
ui.options.beammp.disableLuaReload: Disable Lua reloading when quitting a multiplayer server.
ui.options.beammp.disableLuaReload.toolt: Lua reloads are required to ensure that the game is put back to a working state if mods had replaced game functions. Can be disabled for a smoother experience at your own risk.
ui.options.beammp.simplifyRemoteVehicles: This setting will replace remote vehicles with the BeamNG provided 'traffic' versions. Reduces accuracy of collisions and visuals, but improves performance
ui.options.beammp.enableProxyVehicles.to: Remote vehicles that are far away are drawn as simple coloured boxes instead of being spawned. Only the closest vehicles are spawned as real vehicles. Greatly improves performance on busy servers. Disable to always spawn every vehicle (old behaviour, unspawned vehicles show as blobs).
ui.options.beammp.proxyAutoReal.tooltip: Off: other players' vehicles always stay placeholders, a real vehicle only spawns when you spectate it. On: placeholders closer than the distance below become real vehicles.
ui.options.beammp.proxyRealSpawnDistance: Proxies closer than this are swapped for real vehicles (subject to the limit below).
ui.options.beammp.proxyRealDespawnDistan: Real remote vehicles further away than this are swapped back to proxies. Always kept at least 20 m above the spawn distance.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMaxRealVehicles.t: Maximum number of remote vehicles that are spawned as real vehicles at the same time.
Spawning a real vehicle causes a stutter, at most one is spawned per this many seconds.
ui.options.beammp.proxySwapCooldown.tool: A vehicle that was just swapped (real <-> proxy) will not be swapped again for this many seconds.
ui.options.beammp.proxyDrawDistance.tool: Proxies further away than this are not drawn (nametags still are).
ui.options.beammp.proxyCollision.tooltip: Proxies close to your vehicle get a pooled simplified collision vehicle. The pool is spawned on demand, which causes a short stutter per pooled vehicle.
ui.options.beammp.proxyCollisionRadius.t: Proxies within this distance of your vehicle get a collision vehicle.
Maximum number of pooled collision vehicles.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshEnabled: Show real body meshes on nearby proxies
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshEnabled.toolt: Nearby proxies use the vehicle's real body panels (from its config) instead of a box. The meshes are prepared in the background and cached, the box is shown until they are ready.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshDistance.tool: Proxies closer than this use body meshes, further ones are drawn as boxes.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMaxMeshProxies.to: Maximum number of proxies that use body meshes at the same time (nearest first).
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshWheels.toolti: Draw simple wheels under proxies that use body meshes.
ui.options.beammp.proxySmoothHandover.to: When a proxy is swapped for a real vehicle, the proxy stays visible while the real vehicle spawns hidden, then the real vehicle is placed on the proxy's pose (keeping its velocity) and shown once it has synced.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMaxPrediction.too: How far ahead (in seconds) a proxy's position is predicted from the last packet. Higher hides lag spikes but overshoots more when the driver brakes or turns.
ui.options.beammp.proxyFarShape.tooltip: Proxies without a mesh are drawn as a simple low poly car outline instead of a box.
ui.options.beammp.proxyTargetFps.tooltip: While the frame rate is below this, fewer proxies get body meshes (the rest are drawn as shapes). 0 turns this off.
ui.options.beammp.proxyReplayState: Replay state when a proxy becomes real
ui.options.beammp.proxyReplayState.toolt: Lights, gear, engine state, inputs and broken parts received while a vehicle was a proxy are kept and applied when its real vehicle is ready.
ui.options.beammp.proxyHybridMode.toolti: On servers with few players, remote vehicles are spawned for real but paused and drawn as proxies when they are not near you. Mods that need the real vehicle object keep working and crashes use real physics, at the cost of a spawn stutter per vehicle while joining.
Hybrid mode is only used while the server has at most this many players, above that remote vehicles stay pure proxies.
ui.options.beammp.proxyHybridWakeDistanc: Paused vehicles closer than this are simulated again (nearest first).
ui.options.beammp.proxyHybridMaxAwake.to: At most this many remote vehicles are simulated by distance at once. Vehicles you run into or spectate are always woken.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshTriangleBudge: Most triangles a proxy body mesh may have; the smallest parts are left out until it fits. 0 keeps everything. Changing it rebuilds the meshes.
ui.options.beammp.proxyPrebuildModels: Prebuild proxy meshes for all models
ui.options.beammp.proxyPrebuildModels.to: Builds the default config proxy mesh of every installed model in the background (once, cached on disk), so a proxy can show its model's default look right away while its own config is prepared.
ui.options.beammp.proxyLodFullDistance.t: Proxies closer than this show every mesh of their config.
Up to this distance proxies show their body without interior, mechanical parts and small trim (within the triangle budget).
Up to this distance proxies show only their biggest body panels. Further out they are drawn as a low poly car shape. Also capped by the proxy mesh distance.
Up to this distance proxies without a mesh are drawn as a low poly car shape, further out as a box in their paint colour.
ui.options.beammp.proxyQueueByDistance.t: A queued real spawn of a vehicle that drives out of range is dropped (it stays a proxy) and queued again from its latest config when it comes back. Without the spawn queue it is spawned straight away when back in range.
ui.options.beammp.proxyEngineSound.toolt: Play an engine sound on the nearest proxy vehicles. RPM is estimated from the synced throttle, gear and speed.
ui.options.beammp.proxyEngineSoundDistan: Proxies closer than this get an engine sound.
ui.options.beammp.proxyEngineSoundMax.to: How many proxies can play an engine sound at once, nearest first.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshFrameBudgetMs: Proxy mesh build time per frame
Milliseconds per frame spent building proxy meshes. Lower is smoother, higher builds faster.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshRealWheels: Use real wheel and tire models
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshRealWheels.to: Near proxies (full and parts detail) get the rim and tire meshes of their config, turning with steering and rolling with speed. The plain drawn wheels are used further out and while the wheel meshes are being built.
ui.options.beammp.proxyMeshRealWheelsMax: Most proxies (nearest first) that get real wheel and tire models at once.
ui.options.beammp.enableBlobs.tooltip: Unspawned vehicles will appear as colored spheres (blobs)
ui.options.beammp.showSpectators: Show spectators' nametag under vehicle nametags
ui.options.beammp.showSpectators.tooltip: Players spectating others' vehicles will be listed under their nametags
ui.options.beammp.licensePlateUsesPlayer: Show Player names on license plates
Will show the Player's username on vehicle license plates
ui.options.beammp.spectatorUnifiedColors: Draw all spectator nametags as grey, independent of the user's role
ui.options.beammp.nametagFadeDistance.to: How far nametags will start fading in/stop fading out
ui.options.beammp.nametagCharLimit.toolt: Maximum number of characters you want to see in a nametag
ui.options.beammp.shortenNametags.toolti: Trim long player names and roles
ui.options.beammp.unicycleAutoSave: Automatically save your last used Unicycle
ui.options.beammp.unicycleAutoSave.toolt: When you despawn your Unicycle, it is saved and reused next time you spawn it
ui.options.beammp.skipModSecurityWarning: Skip the mod security warning popup
Disable the security popup when joining modded servers.
ui.options.beammp.refreshIngame: Allow the serverlist to refresh ingame
ui.options.beammp.refreshIngame.tooltip: Whether to allow the server list to refresh whilst in a session. Enabling this can cause lag spikes.
ui.options.beammp.useUiAppRedesign.toolt: Choose the visual style for BeamMP's HUD apps.
